what: On open, a backdrop-color curtain covers the screen, and at its center the logo pieces (layers like four brush strokes) sharpen one at a time, every .3s starting at 1.5s, from blur 5px and transparent, after 2.7s the whole curtain lifts away in 1s

options.hold: Time when the curtain starts to lift (s), default 2.7
options.delay: Delay for the first piece (seconds), default 0 — fuji-gen .1
options.ease: Piece curve (CSS — four cubic-bezier numbers or a CSS name), default 0.07,0.36,0.66,0.97 — fuji-gen power4.out ≈ 0.165,0.84,0.44,1
options.out-ease: Curtain reveal curve (CSS), default 0.09,0.36,0.63,1 — one project’s power1.out ≈ 0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94
options.[data-fx-part=layer]: Logo pieces that sharpen in sequence (stacked)
options.look: On out, the pieces stand sharp from the first image, then after delay they blur and vanish over dur — the veil holds separately and lifts on out (Studio #loading logo .appear{opacity:1}, brand). By default the pieces go from blurred to sharp

note: The curtain covers the screen with fixed, then once lifted turns off pointer-events and becomes hidden. On screens that change often, use shorter hold and dur

from.where: shared.css .sg-opening — original #opening: brush-script logo in 4 layers blur(5px) .3s apart 1.5s cubic-bezier(.07,.36,.66,.97), curtain opacity 1→0 after 2.7s for 1s cubic-bezier(.09,.36,.63,1)

index.html .fg-opening — original scripts.js siteOpening: a single logo at the center of the white curtain goes opacity 0·blur(30px) → 1·0 in 1s power4.out (delayed .1), then the curtain goes opacity 0 in 1.5s power1.out (delayed .1 → starts at 1.2s). When the curtain starts to lift, the Hero slider and copy start (the site follows the GSAP timeline as is)

index.html .dj-intro — original intro.js·#intro: 1s after window.onload the sentence (emblem) goes opacity 0 → 1 over 2s ease (no blur), 1s later the two letters do the same, then 2s after that (at 4s) the whole black curtain goes opacity 0 over 2s ease. The curtain uses the stage colour opposite the background, so the consuming css switches background to --kf-contrast-bg. To count from load like the original, the site attaches data-fx at load, and until then holds only the black curtain with its own css (transparent pieces of .dj-intro:not(.fx-lb-out)).
from.options: each: 1; dur: 2; delay: 1; hold: 4; out: 2; blur: 0; ease: ease; out-ease: ease

from.where: index.html .et-loading — original Studio #loading: a background-color curtain (faint doodle pattern laid over) with the logo visible from the first paint. Once appear is released (~.5s after opening), the logo turns transparent after a 1.5s delay over 1.5s ease, and the curtain lifts after a 1s delay over 2.5s cubic-bezier(.45,0,.55,1). Matched to the loader length measured with motion-probe (original 2.7s), so slightly earlier than the original values (delay 1.5 · curtain 1s)
from.options: look: out; delay: 0.95; dur: 1.5; blur: 0; hold: 0.45; out: 2.5; ease: ease; out-ease: 0.45,0,0.55,1
